assaultinfo_enabled_desc: Show the info box (full info as host, reduced as client)
assaultinfo_show_stealth_desc: Show the box while the raid is still stealthy
assaultinfo_show_time_desc: Show the time until the assault ends
assaultinfo_show_enemies_desc: Show assault enemies alive / target force
assaultinfo_show_kills_left_desc: Show kills left until the assault falls back to fade
assaultinfo_y_pos_desc: Distance from the top of the screen (0 = top, 1 = bottom)
assaultinfo_reset_confirm: Are you sure, you want to reset all AssaultInfo options to their default value?
